description: This file defines the 'telegram-status' module, which manages the status and auditing of Telegram accounts within the openclaw plugin SDK. It includes functions for loading modules, resolving runtime configurations, and creating an account status adapter with methods for probing, auditing, and snapshotting Telegram account states.

methods.name: loadTelegramAuditModule
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the audit module for Telegram.

methods.name: loadTelegramProbeModule
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the probe module for Telegram.

methods.name: getOptionalTelegramRuntime
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the current Telegram runtime configuration, returns null if unavailable.

methods.name: resolveTelegramProbe
methods.description: Resolves the probe function for Telegram, either from runtime or by loading the module.

methods.name: resolveTelegramAuditCollector
methods.description: Resolves the audit collector function for Telegram, either from runtime or by loading the module.

methods.name: resolveTelegramAuditMembership
methods.description: Resolves the audit membership function for Telegram, either from runtime or by loading the module.
